games.title: Body Builder Zoo
games.skillName: Comparing the bodies of fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to identify and name a variety of common animals including fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals; describe and compare the structure of a variety of common animals (fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals, including pets)
games.instruction: Read the body clues, then tap the animal group.
games.hint: Not quite. Think about the animal's skin or covering, then try again.

questions.ask: Has fins and scales, and breathes underwater with gills
Has feathers, a beak and two wings
Has hair or fur and feeds its babies milk
Has dry, scaly skin and lays eggs on land
Has smooth, damp skin and starts life in water as a tadpole
A pet goldfish: fins, scales and gills
A pet rabbit: soft fur, four legs and long ears
A pet budgie: feathers, a beak and two legs
A pet tortoise: dry, scaly skin and a hard shell
A frog: smooth, damp skin and long back legs for jumping
